title: Matterbridge Open Tuya
description: matterbridge-open-tuya by https://github.com/cheziyi. Your Tuya account and devices are set up in the guided setup: open the plugin frontend from the plugin's row on the home page.

pollIntervalInSeconds.title: Poll Interval
pollIntervalInSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, the state and the readings of each device are read (10 to 3600). A device sends a change of its state by itself, so this mostly sets how soon a device that is unplugged shows as unreachable.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.
